description: Estimates what silent fabric degradation (slow NCCL collectives, flapping links, congestion) costs a GPU cluster: throughput lost, GPU-hours and dollars per year, idle-GPU equivalent, cost per degraded hour, extra days on a training run, and the value of a recovery scenario with a conservative case and a sensitivity table. All assumptions are inputs with stated defaults.

bandwidth_loss_pct.description: Collective bus bandwidth lost while degraded, vs. healthy. Measure with nccl-tests (see analyze_nccl_benchmark). Default 40.

comm_share_pct.description: Share of a healthy training step spent in collective communication that is NOT overlapped with compute. Typically 10 to 40% for large-scale training. Default 25.

degraded_time_pct.description: Share of running time the fabric is degraded (flapping links, congestion, bad cables/optics, misrouted paths). Default 10.

gpu_count.description: Total GPUs in the cluster (or in the jobs being analyzed).

gpu_hour_cost_usd.description: Actual fully-loaded cost per GPU-hour in USD (amortized hardware + power + facility, or cloud rate). Strongly preferred over the default.

gpu_model.description: GPU model, used only to pick a default cost per GPU-hour when gpu_hour_cost_usd is not given.

recovery_pct.description: Recovery scenario: share of the degradation-induced throughput loss you expect to recover by detecting and acting on degradation sooner. A planning assumption, not a measured XportL result. Default 25.

training_run_days.description: Optional: planned wall-clock length of one training run on this cluster, to show how many days degradation adds to it.

utilization_pct.description: Share of hours the GPUs are running distributed jobs. Default 80.

name: calculate_fabric_degradation_cost
title: Fabric Degradation Cost Calculator
